During the study, subjects were placed in various conditions (food deprivation, prolonged confinement in a restricted space, blood loss exceeding 20/30/40% of total blood volume, burns with ITP from 50 to 95 points, acute and subacute intoxication). Compounds SJ6, eTG-c, and SJ1 demonstrated significant effectiveness in stabilizing condition and activating the organism’s reserve resources in poisoning of varying severity and intoxication in the presence of open wounds. Compounds SJ15 and M.U.L.E. demonstrated high effectiveness under favorable conditions and increased subjects’ activity periods by 47–60%. As a result of the studies, eTG-c, SJ6, and SJ15 are recommended for further iteration and development. The lack of professional training among test subjects negatively affected research results, therefore when used on trained combat personnel, the projected effect may reach higher results. The research group associates these effects with excessive wear of muscle tissue and the organism’s inability to recover after such pressure. It is recommended to develop an advanced version of these compounds in which, after administration of the functional composition, a restorative mixture is also administered to replace expended physiological resources. 68ffff7d3caa9d0cab08fc99:
Jaeger’s friend is trying to learn what happened to the BEAR squad that stormed The Labyrinth during the evacuation. The team completed their operation, but then all contact went dead and The Labyrinth was sealed. In exchange for the Knossos keycards, Jaeger wants me to find out what happened to them. I’ll have to carefully sweep all the passages in The Labyrinth and figure out what went on after the assault.

It’s not an easy job, but I’ll get a better understanding of the complex and a chance to dig up TerraGroup research. So it’s worth doing, and it’ll help build my rep with Jaeger. He gave me a Knossos keycard that should open The Labyrinth entrance. The way into the TerraGroup complex is now open.

68ffffef2f2048e6e505f0c2:
Now it’s clear what happened to the BEAR squad after the assault. Right after the team got in, the Labyrinth staff locked all the entrances and exits. Then the senior employee released the test subjects from their cages. These people had long been on the brink of madness and exhaustion, and they took out all the BEARs, even though they were unarmed and had no combat training.

A terrible fate… but knowing the truth is better than living a lie.
